description: Canonical schema for the Phase 3 Lost Deal Recovery synthetic CRM dataset.

columns.name: record_id
columns.description: Stable unique identifier for the canonical record.

columns.name: record_type
columns.description: Canonical record classification.

columns.name: observed_at
columns.description: Observation date normalized to ISO UTC datetime. Source provides date only.

columns.name: entity_id
columns.description: Stable entity reference derived from the source deal ID.

columns.name: related_entity_id
columns.description: Related entity identifier. Blank because no separate related-entity ID was supplied.

columns.name: entity_name
columns.description: Company associated with the lost deal.

columns.name: category
columns.description: Lost-deal reason category.

columns.name: subcategory
columns.description: Product associated with the deal.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Operational priority supplied by the source dataset.

columns.name: stage
columns.description: Deal stage supplied by the source dataset.

columns.name: metric_name
columns.description: Name of the numeric metric represented by metric_value.

columns.name: metric_value
columns.description: Numeric deal value from the source.

columns.name: metric_unit
columns.description: Unit label for the monetary metric. Source does not explicitly identify the currency.

columns.name: text_value
columns.description: Recovery action text supplied by the source.
columns.example: Re-engage with ROI comparison and flexible pricing.

columns.name: latitude
columns.description: Latitude. No coordinates were supplied.

columns.name: longitude
columns.description: Longitude. No coordinates were supplied.

columns.name: source_name
columns.description: Name identifying the source dataset.

columns.name: source_record_id
columns.description: Identifier of the original source record.

columns.name: is_synthetic
columns.description: Indicates that the record is synthetic.

columns.name: data_version
columns.description: Version identifier for this canonical data package.
